summary: Tested Dynamic Thermal Receipt Settings backend + Admin panel + Courier reprint wiring end-to-end. All 5 receipt-settings pytest tests PASS (GET auto-seed, PUT persist, dedupe, append-missing-slots, reject-invalid-paper-width). Admin panel /admin -> Pengaturan Nota fully functional: header slot drag via slot-up/slot-down works, store_name edit + paper 58/80mm toggle persist across reload (verified via API + UI reload), toast 'Pengaturan nota tersimpan' shown on save, all 3 preview buttons (preview-customer/preview-production/preview-bagtag) open new print window with valid HTML (5288 / 5088 / 3891 chars, store_name change reflected). Courier Dashboard ANTAREUN tab: 4 reprint-ready-* icon buttons on ready-cards + 4 reprint-motor-* buttons on motor-cards; clicking either opens the shared reprint-modal with correct order id + customer name in description and all 3 template rows (reprint-model-customer / -production / -bagtag) with labels 'Nota Pelanggan', 'Slip Produksi', 'Label Bag / Pack'.

minor.issue: Spec expected: 'header_order=[] returns 422'. Actual: current behavior silently fills header_order with KNOWN_HEADER_SLOTS (['speed','qr','logo']) via _sanitize_header_order and returns 200. The 'if not fresh[header_order]: raise 422' check is unreachable because the sanitizer always appends the 3 known slots. Either accept the defensive fallback (and update the spec/test) or move the empty-check BEFORE calling _sanitize_header_order. Non-blocking — current behavior is arguably safer for the UI.

action_items: OPTIONAL: decide whether PUT /api/receipt-settings with header_order=[] should 422 (as the review spec says) or silently fall back to the 3 default slots (current behavior). If 422 is desired, move the empty-check above _sanitize_header_order in receipt_settings.py.
critical_code_review_comments: receipt_settings.py _sanitize_header_order: cleanly de-dupes and appends missing slots; but combined with the empty-check below, the 422 branch is dead code. Consider validating input first, then sanitizing.
ReceiptSettings pydantic model uses `pattern=r'^(58mm|80mm)$'` on paper_width — correctly returns 422 on invalid values (verified). Good use of Field validation.

CourierDashboard reprint wiring is clean: buildCourierPrintPayload is shared between ready + motor paths, reprint-modal shows order id + customer, and pop-up-blocked case surfaces a proper toast. All required data-testids present (reprint-ready-{id}, reprint-motor-{id}, reprint-modal, reprint-model-{customer|production|bagtag}).

Admin ReceiptSettings.jsx: solid UI with all needed data-testids (slot-row-*, slot-up-*, slot-down-*, paper-58mm/80mm, store-input-*, preview-*, save-receipt-settings). After reload the persisted values are correctly re-populated in the form and preview windows use the fresh settings (verified 'LaundryMax Test 2026' appears in preview-customer HTML).
Recurring Recharts warning 'width(-1) height(-1)' fires on admin Overview when chart container mounts before flex layout resolves — cosmetic only, not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on scope (Admin panel + Courier reprint modal)

test_credentials: Admin: seeded owner session via Mongo user_sessions with token 'test_session_owner_<uuid>' + user email theomahrizal@gmail.com, forwarded via localStorage.laundrymax_session_token (per auth_testing.md Step 1). Courier: bypassed StaffPinGate by setting sessionStorage staff_pin_ok/id/name/role = Budi/Kurir.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed/all -> 35 orders (Packing=4, OTW=4 used for reprint tests), 6 staff, 5 customers.

Courier gate can be bypassed with sessionStorage keys staff_pin_ok='true', staff_pin_id/name/role. Reprint modal testids on CourierDashboard.jsx: reprint-ready-{orderId}, reprint-motor-{orderId}, reprint-modal, reprint-model-{customer|production|bagtag}. Admin ReceiptSettings testids: header-order-card, slot-row-{speed|qr|logo}, slot-up-*/slot-down-*, store-input-{store_name|store_address|store_phone|footer_message}, paper-{58mm|80mm}, preview-{customer|production|bagtag}, save-receipt-settings, receipt-refresh-btn. Backend receipt-settings persistence verified live. Note: header_order=[] currently returns 200 with defaults (not 422) — spec drift.
rca of the issue: N/A — the only spec deviation (header_order=[] not returning 422) is a design choice: _sanitize_header_order always appends KNOWN_HEADER_SLOTS so the empty-check downstream is unreachable. Simple mitigation if 422 is required: `if not payload.header_order: raise HTTPException(422, 'header_order cannot be empty')` BEFORE the sanitizer.
